description: This module fails the progress with a custom message.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: The customized message used for failing execution. If omitted, fail will simply bail out with a generic message. Default: "Failed as requested from task"

examples:
- name: Example using fail and when together
  ansible.builtin.fail:
    msg: The system may not be provisioned according to the CMDB status.
  when: cmdb_status != "to-be-staged"
